REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 3 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 4 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Option 5 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

output_text:
```python
import os
from mindee import Client, Type
from mindee.api import ApiClient

def extract_receipt_data(image_path):
    # Initialize the Mindee client with API key from environment
    mindee_client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("MINDEE_API_KEY"))
    
    # Load and parse the receipt document
    input_doc = mindee_client.doc_from_path(image_path)
    result = input_doc.parse(Type.Invoice)
    
    # Extract structured data
    invoice = result.document
    merchant = invoice.vendor_name
    tax = invoice.total_tax.amount if invoice.total_tax else None
    total = invoice.total_amount.amount if invoice.total_amount else None
    
    # Extract line items
    items = []
    if hasattr(invoice, 'line_items') and invoice.line_items:
        for item in invoice.line_items:
            items.append({
                'description': item.description,
                'quantity': item.quantity,
                'unit_price': item.unit_price.amount if item.unit_price else None,
                'total_price': item.total_amount.amount if item.total_amount else None
            })
    
    return {
        'merchant': merchant,
        'tax': tax,
        'total': total,
        'items': items
    }
```
